evidence: QuantConnect official US Equities documentation states its live US equity data consolidates across all exchanges, is powered by the Securities Information Processor (SIP), and has 100% market coverage.
QuantConnect supports live equity trade and quote tick data, making strict A/B technically strong when run in the qualifying live environment.
QuantConnect official pricing/deployment documentation gives the Free organization tier zero live trading nodes; Paper Trading and Live Trading are unavailable on Free.
The QuantConnect live data provider is supported in cloud but not as a local data provider. Local LEAN deployments must use a brokerage or supported third-party provider.
The LEAN CLI authentication and local live-deploy documentation require membership in an organization on a paid tier.

Therefore the free SIP dataset/data-provider statement cannot be converted into a permanent-$0 scheduler-callable strict G9 path: the qualifying live runtime is paid-tier conditioned and the QuantConnect SIP provider cannot be used as a free local-provider escape hatch.

gate_analysis.A: STRONG_PASS_SEMANTICS: official SIP, consolidated all exchanges, 100% coverage
gate_analysis.B: STRONG_TECHNICAL_PATH: live trade+quote ticks; same-run freshness still required if entitlement path existed
gate_analysis.C: FAIL: qualifying live runtime/CLI access is paid-tier conditioned
gate_analysis.D: FAIL_PERMANENT_ZERO: Free tier has zero live nodes; official QuantConnect SIP provider unavailable for local deployments

reopen_condition: Only reopen if QuantConnect permits Free-tier scheduler/live access to the SIP US-equities provider, either through at least one free live node or an officially supported free local QuantConnect data-provider path, without paid-tier condition.
